card.name: Commas and words before reaction terms
card.fires_on: Commas after skin or allergy symptoms in a list (pruritus, burning, erythema), and words like adverse or infusion just before reactions. It is mostly in adverse-reaction and warning sections.

modes.label: Comma in symptom list
modes.description: The comma right after a skin or allergy symptom, with another symptom expected next.
